mutations.name: a tags/ or v<digit> segment anywhere in a destination reads as a tag
kills: normal work classifies nothing git push to a branch whose name holds tags/

mutations.name: a readHead that throws reads as no branch checked out
kills: one fixture per bash.merge spelling a readHead that throws reads as an unknown protected head git push origin HEAD
one fixture per bash.merge spelling a readHead that throws reads as an unknown protected head git merge x

mutations.name: config routes only a push with no refspec
kills: a push the command's own -c or --config-env config routes onto a protected branch a remote push refspec mapping the named branch reads as a push to main

mutations.name: config routes an explicit src:dst refspec too
kills: a push the command's own -c or --config-env config routes onto a protected branch an explicit src:dst refspec, which git does not map pushes no protected branch

mutations.name: --tags with no refspec still routes through config
kills: a push the command's own -c or --config-env config routes onto a protected branch --tags with no refspec pushes no protected branch

mutations.name: any branch upstream satisfies push.default=upstream
kills: a push the command's own -c or --config-env config routes onto a protected branch push.default=upstream with another branch's upstream reads as a push to an unknown branch
